interpretation: RHUH's planned 40 post-treatment subjects are valuable for directional robustness but are unlikely by themselves to resolve a paired Dice effect near 0.016. Any future cross-cohort synthesis must be preregistered as a meta-analysis and must not pool scans while ignoring subjects or cohort differences.
limitations: rough normal approximation using the observed UCSD subject-delta variance; not a guarantee, not a significance test, and not used for model or threshold selection
